title: World Historical Gazetteer: Web Platform & API
description:
An open-source platform for linking, visualising, and sharing data about historical places. Built with Python/Django and PostgreSQL/PostGIS, the World Historical Gazetteer (WHG) provides researchers and institutions with tools for managing spatial-temporal historical data.

Key capabilities:

  • Data integration — upload and reconcile historical place data against global authorities
  • Collaborative curation — built-in provenance tracking and multi-user workflows
  • Visualisation — interactive maps and timelines for spatial-temporal analysis
  • APIs — programmatic access to the WHG index, including a W3C-conformant Reconciliation Service API

This release corresponds to v3.2 (ORCID authentication, Reconciliation Service API, and PeriodO filters) with the addition of machine-readable citation metadata.

Documentation: docs.whgazetteer.org
